comments.author: Lynn
comments.content: I ordered the WIFI 5 IN ONE. DO NOT USE THE TUYA APP. DOWN LOAD & use the Smart life app. The way this is advertised it look like 1 user can use all the ways to unlock the door, but a user is BOUND to only 1 way of unlocking the app. the seller was of little to no help in figuring out why neither of these 2 different WIFI locks were not working with the recommended Tuya app. if I didn't already have a lot of home automation devices, I would have been enraged and returned the products. the instruction booklets are CRAP. When they tell you to reset the device there isn't even a diagram showing the VERY VERY TINY RESET BUTTON or hole that has to be pushed to reset it. If I set this lock to be bound to my finger print, it does not bind 1 particular print but ANY fingerprint print will open the lock -see video. if I set it to a pin for me then every one has to use that pin. it is supposed to be individual pin numbers for each user and should be able to have each user had both a pin snd an finger print to open the lock that is specific to them. seller was of 0 help. I currently have received more help from the Smart life app. it won't even load to control with the recommended app. if you buy it be tech savvy. I will not buy this again!
comments.seller_respond: Seller Response 2023-11-10 Hello, when entering fingerprints, after entering one person's fingerprint, you need to click Confirm before you can enter another person's fingerprint. In this way, the fingerprint name is separate, just like when setting a fingerprint password on a mobile phone, they are all separate. , only after setting and naming each person individually can another fingerprint be entered. Helpful(0)
